parsed.main_gap: The graph need not be acyclic globally; the chosen component containing \(a_q\) may contain a cycle or loop, so its asserted bipartition is unjustified.

errors.description: Having fewer edges than vertices does not exclude cycles or loops: a cyclic component may coexist with isolated vertices. The repair is to choose a component with \(e_C<v_C\), which must be a tree, rather than the component containing \(a_q\).
errors.quote: Having fewer edges than vertices, the graph contains no cycle and no loop, since a cycle or a loop on v vertices already uses at least v edges; hence every connected component C has e_C=v_C-1 and is a tree (an isolated vertex counts as a tree). We use the component containing the vertex of a_q.

parsed.notes: This is a critical flaw in the refinement lower bound as written, but it has a short, straightforward repair. The remaining drafting, refinement-construction, and matching-bound arguments are coherent.
